query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `course_certificates` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `courseId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `userName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `courseName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `certificateNumber` varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `topicsCompleted` int NOT NULL,
  `quizzesPassed` int NOT NULL,
  `averageScore` int NOT NULL,
  `issuedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `course_certificates_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `spaced_repetition_queue` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `courseId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `topicId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `questionId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `failedAttempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `easeFactor` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 250,
  `intervalDays` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `nextReviewAt` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `lastReviewedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `status` enum('pending','due','mastered') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `spaced_repetition_queue_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `community_stats` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `courseId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `topicId` varchar(64),
  `totalAttempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `totalCorrect` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `averageAccuracy` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `totalUsers` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `eli5UsageRate` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `averageAttemptsToPass` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `lastUpdatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `community_stats_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
